game_title: Branching Tale – Coral Reef Shallows Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows, reef shallows: the harbor master must handle smugglers while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Branching Tale: Make story choices that run different if/elif branches toward different endings.
theme: Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows: reef shallows
core_gameplay_loop: In Coral Reef Shallows, repeat each round: Make story choices that run different if/elif branches toward different endings. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the story_trust value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about story_trust to power up the harbor master and open the ship's hull.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 6 (applied tier): Branching Tale
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Branching Tale' (Week 3 slot 12), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Coral Reef Shallows'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how story_trust changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smugglers in Coral Reef Shallows.
